Any customer who has a complaint with Bob's Discount Furniture may contact the company's customer care liaison team directly by email at . I am submitting this complaint regarding Bob’s Discount Furniture due to repeated delivery of defective merchandise, failed attempts to remedy the issue, and the significant inconvenience and loss of work time I have experienced. I have taken time off work on multiple occasions to accommodate deliveries and service visits, yet I am still left with a broken piece of furniture in my home. I respectfully request that this complaint remain open until Bob’s Discount Furniture agrees to issue a full refund with no further inconvenience to me as the customer. I contacted customer service for a partial refund and they said they could refund $149 in shipping fees but that I must be able to accept a new stool delivery.
